suggestedApps.name: INFN Analytics.
suggestedApps.description:
**The Problem:**
Running a successful Zid store means juggling multiple challenges - tracking sales performance, understanding customer behavior, managing inventory, recovering abandoned carts, and making data-driven decisions. Most merchants struggle with:

- **Scattered Data:** Sales, customers, and product data spread across different reports
- **Manual Analysis:** Spending hours creating reports instead of growing the business
- **Lost Revenue:** Missing abandoned cart recovery and customer retention opportunities
- **Poor Visibility:** Not knowing which products perform best or which customers are most valuable
- **Reactive Management:** Making business decisions based on gut feeling rather than data

 **How INFN Helps:**

- **Unified Analytics Dashboard:** All your Zid store data in one comprehensive platform - sales, customers, products, and performance metrics at a glance.

- **AI-Powered Insights:** Get intelligent recommendations for pricing, inventory, marketing campaigns, and customer retention automatically.

- **Revenue Recovery:** Automated abandoned cart recovery with personalized messages to convert lost sales into revenue.

- **Customer Intelligence:** Understand customer lifetime value, purchase behavior, and segmentation for targeted marketing.

- **Real-Time Monitoring:** Live dashboard updates with instant notifications for important business events.

- **Business Growth:** Make data-driven decisions that increase sales, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction.

**Result:** Transform your Zid store from reactive management to proactive growth with actionable insights that drive real business results.

**Integration Steps:**
1. Choose the plan that best suits your needs.
2. Activate the application.
3. The integration will be complete, and you can start using the app.

suggestedApps.name: Datajar
suggestedApps.description:
**Stop guessing what your store data is telling you.**

Most Zid merchants have all the numbers and none of the answers. The orders are there, the products are there — but working out which product actually makes money, which customers stopped coming back, or why last month was slower means exporting spreadsheets and hoping you built the report right.

Datajar is the AI analytics agent for your Zid store. Connect in one click and ask your store anything, in Arabic or English. No dashboards to build, no reports to export, no analyst to hire. Ask a question — get the answer as a chart or a table, in seconds.

**Ask your store anything**
* Sales & revenue — "How did sales this week compare to last week?"
* Best sellers & slow movers — what to restock, what to discount, what to drop
* Inventory — what is about to run out, and what is tying up your cash
* Customers — who buys again, who is slipping away, what your repeat buyers are worth
* Pricing & profit — where discounts and shipping quietly eat your margin

**How it works**
1. Connect your Zid store — one click from the Zid dashboard. No code, no setup, no developer.
2. Datajar syncs your data — orders, products and customers, including your history.
3. Start asking — in plain Arabic or English. Answers in seconds, as charts and tables you can act on.

**See ads and orders in one place** 
Connect your Meta, TikTok or Google Ads accounts alongside your Zid store, and Datajar reads them together — so you can see which campaigns bring real orders and real profit, not just clicks.

**Why Zid merchants choose Datajar**
* Arabic or English — ask in the language you think in
* No dashboards, no spreadsheets — and no analyst on payroll
* Answers in seconds — not a report you get next week
* Useful on day one — your history syncs when you connect, so the first answer is a real answer
* Privacy-first — Datajar analyzes your business numbers, never your customers' personal data

**Questions merchants ask**
* Do I need any technical skills? No. If you can send a WhatsApp message, you can use Datajar.
* What data does Datajar read? Your orders, products and customers from Zid — to explain how your store is performing and where your growth is.
* Can I ask in Arabic? Yes. Ask in Arabic or English and get the answer back in the same language.
* How long does setup take? One click. Most merchants ask their first question within minutes of connecting.
* What does it cost? Start free. Upgrade only when you want more data sources and deeper analysis.


Start free — connect your Zid store and ask your first question today.
suggestedApps.short_description: Your AI analyst for Zid: sales, profit and customer analytics in Arabic or English.

suggestedApps.name: Nabd - Live Sales Screen
suggestedApps.description:
Turn your office TV into a live sales screen your whole team can see.

Your store's sales usually sit in the Zid dashboard, where only the owner sees them. With Nabd, your packing, customer service and marketing teams see every new order within seconds, and know how much is left to the next bonus.

Features:
• Live within seconds: every new order appears right away, with a pop-up showing its amount and an optional chime.
• Bonus levels: up to 8 levels with the amounts and rewards you choose, a progress bar and the amount left to the next level.
• A celebration at every goal: confetti and a fanfare each time the team reaches a level.
• Daily or monthly goal: the counter restarts every midnight, or builds up until the end of the month.
• Chart: sales by hour to show your peak times, or by day for a monthly goal.
• Any screen, as many as you like: TV, monitor or phone, and the same link works on several screens at once.
• Arabic and English.

Honest numbers, respected privacy:
• Cancelled, returned and unpaid orders don't count, and an order cancelled after it appears is subtracted automatically.
• The screen never shows payment details, phone numbers or addresses, and customer names are hidden by default.
• Your screen link is private. You can replace it with one click, and the old link stops working immediately.
• Nabd only reads orders and never changes anything in your store.

Ready in three steps:
1. Install Nabd from the Zid App Market and go straight to your dashboard.
2. Set your goals and rewards.
3. Open your screen link on the office TV.

No passwords, no software to install. 7-day free trial, then just 9 SAR once instead of 19 SAR.
suggestedApps.short_description: Live sales screen for your Zid store on the office TV, with bonus levels that motivate your team.
